title: Nine Grains of Powder
subtitle: 胶囊与太空舱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 胶囊与太空舱（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）
meta: 主题语境：胶囊与太空舱（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）　|　核心词汇：capsule　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 capsule 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my mother was sent to count ① a capsule she could not swallow, and she said the swallowing was the whole of the lesson. The ② capsule, meaning the shell and not the powder, was nine grains and was counted by whoever came last; a capsule, she said, is the only thing in a dispensary that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ capsule in that dispensary had the same label, and the ④ capsule at the front, meaning the one the nurse kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. A capsule, my grandmother said, is nine parts gelatine and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the gelatine is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ capsule was the whole of the flight, meaning the craft it carried and not the shell. The ⑥ capsule, meaning the flight and not any of that, is the only thing in a programme that everybody watches and nobody questions; a capsule, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a shell and a flight. She said the flight is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ capsule had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the label. The ⑧ capsule of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine grains and eleven years of counting; a capsule, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ capsule I remember is the one at the front, which was opened in 1981 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ capsule, my grandmother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being opened; every capsule, she said, is a flight that has agreed to look like a shell. She said the flight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 胶囊（指那层外壳本身，与药粉相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a capsule 清点一粒胶囊
D. n. 胶囊（指药房里每一粒）
E. n. 胶囊（指前面那一粒）
F. n. 太空舱（抽象：它承载的那次飞行）
G. n. 那次飞行（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a capsule she could not swallow
The capsule, meaning the shell and not the powder
capsule was the whole of the flight
the capsule had become a photograph in a report
The capsule of the whole thing
A capsule, my grandmother said in 1986

answers.why: count a capsule 意为“清点一粒胶囊”，1962 年母亲被派去清点一粒她吞不下的胶囊。
capsule 意为“胶囊”，指那层外壳本身而不是药粉，装九格令，由最后走的人清点。
capsule 指药房里每一粒胶囊，每一粒都是同样的标签。
capsule 指前面那一粒（护士留的那一粒），是唯一有人认真清点过的。
capsule 意为“太空舱”，抽象指它承载的那次飞行，父亲说 capsule 就是那次飞行的全部。
capsule 为抽象用法，指那次飞行本身，是计划里人人都守着看、却没人质疑的东西。
capsule 意为“胶囊、太空舱”，到 1977 年这粒 capsule 成了报告里的一张照片。
capsule 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九格令和十一年的清点。
capsule 意为“胶囊”，我记得的是前面那一粒，1981 年被拆开，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
capsule 为抽象总称，祖母说胶囊是唯一会因为被拆开服用而变好的东西。
